steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Bring **6 cups water** to a rapid boil. Add **½ cup brown rice**. Cover, bring to a full boil, and let cook 3 minutes.

steps.title: Add the peas
steps.body: Add **2 cups split peas**. Cook 30 minutes more.

steps.title: Add the vegetables
steps.body: Add **2 tsp salt**, **1 cup sautéed onions, chopped**, **½ cup finely diced carrots** and **½ cup finely diced celery**. Cook 10–15 minutes.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.body: Add **½ tsp basil**. Test and season to taste. Serve over a slice of whole wheat bread.
